installation.live_ui: Chrome reviewed the collapsed policy tree, integration and device expansion, search, preserved choices, Monitoring entity details, the exact native Home Assistant entity dialog and its return, shared issue groups and the simplified device issue dialog. limits: Physical Safari and notification-provider receipt were not tested.
